translation: Flavor sweet, neutral. It mainly wards off inauspiciousness, treats wind dizziness [風眩], wind deficiency [風虛], the five kinds of exhaustion and seven kinds of damage [五勞七傷], dry mouth, stops palpitations, excessive anger and anger, forgetfulness, opens the heart and boosts wisdom, settles the hun and po [魂魄], and nourishes essence and spirit. It grows beneath great pines on Mount Tai.
